s0003.literal: The Deposed Emperor's taboo name was Bozong, style name Fengye, childhood name Yaowang; he was Emperor Wen's legitimate eldest son.
s0003.idiomatic: The Deposed Emperor, taboo name Bozong, styled Fengye and in youth called Yaowang, was the legitimate eldest son of Emperor Wen.

s0004.literal: He was born on gengyin day of the fifth month in the third year of Liang's Chengsheng era.
s0004.idiomatic: He was born on gengyin day in the fifth month of the third year of Liang's Chengsheng era (554).

s0005.literal: On wuchen day of the second month in the second year of Yongding, he was appointed heir of the Prince of Linchuan.
s0005.idiomatic: In Yongding year 2, on wuchen day of the second month, he was named heir of the Prince of Linchuan.

s0006.literal: In year three Emperor Wen succeeded to the throne; on gengxu day of the eighth month he was established as crown prince.
s0006.idiomatic: In year 3, when Emperor Wen took the throne, he was made crown prince on gengxu day of the eighth month.

s0007.literal: Editorial footnote marker 1. Since the Liang house fell into chaos and separation, the eastern palace was burned to ashes, and the crown prince dwelt in Yongfu Province.
s0007.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker 1. After the Liang court was torn apart, the eastern palace lay in ashes, and the crown prince lived in Yongfu Province.

s0008.literal: On guiyou day of the fourth month in the first year of Tiankang, Emperor Wen died; that same day the crown prince took the throne in the Hall before the Supreme Ultimate and issued an edict: "Heaven has sent down calamity; the late emperor has suddenly abandoned the myriad realms. We cannot reach him with our cries; Our five viscera are shattered.
s0008.idiomatic: On guiyou day of the fourth month in Tiankang year 1, Emperor Wen died. That same day the crown prince ascended the throne in the hall before the Supreme Ultimate and proclaimed: "Heaven has sent calamity; the late emperor has left the realm. We cannot reach him with our laments; Our inmost being is broken.

s0009.literal: We, of meager virtue, have succeeded to the precious mandate; night and day in grief We fear greatly for the jade beads of the cap, and just now rely on the chief ministers to correct Our shortcomings.
s0009.idiomatic: We, of little merit, have received the sacred charge; day and night in mourning We fear for the realm as for loose cap-strings, and now depend on our ministers to mend what We lack.

s0010.literal: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm."
s0010.idiomatic: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm."

s0011.literal: Another edict ordered all civil and military officials within and without to resume their offices, and all distant regions to cease rushing to court.
s0011.idiomatic: A further edict ordered civil and military officers at court and in the provinces to return to their posts, and forbade distant regions to hurry envoys to the capital.

s0014.literal: Editorial footnote marker 2. On jimao day the empress dowager was honored as grand empress dowager, and the empress as empress dowager.
s0014.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker 2. On jimao day the empress dowager was raised to grand empress dowager and the empress to empress dowager.

s0015.literal: On gengyin day the Prince of Ancheng, Xu, bearer of the staff, minister of works, inspector of Yangzhou, and newly appointed director of the Masters of Writing, was made Bearer of the Staff, Grand General of Agile Cavalry, advanced to grand mentor, recorder of the Masters of Writing, and area commander over all armies within and without.
s0015.idiomatic: On gengyin day Xu, Prince of Ancheng—bearer of the staff, minister of works, inspector of Yangzhou, and newly named director of the Masters of Writing—was made grand general of agile cavalry with the staff, promoted to grand mentor and recorder of the Masters of Writing, and given overall command of armies at court and in the field.

s0016.literal: On dingyou day Central Army General, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Xu Du was advanced to minister of works;
s0016.idiomatic: On dingyou day Xu Du, central army general and opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, was promoted to minister of works;

s0017.literal: Garrisoning South General, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Inspector of Jiangzhou Zhang Zhaoda became palace attendant and was advanced in title to General Who Campaigns South;
s0017.idiomatic: Zhang Zhaoda, garrisoning south general, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and inspector of Jiangzhou, became palace attendant and was promoted to general who campaigns south;

s0018.literal: Garrisoning East General and Inspector of East Yangzhou, the Prince of Shixing, Bomao, was advanced in title to General Who Campaigns East and opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes;
s0018.idiomatic: Bomao, Prince of Shixing, garrisoning east general and inspector of East Yangzhou, was promoted to general who campaigns east with a mansion equal to the three dukes;

s0019.literal: Pacifying North General and Inspector of South Xuzhou, the Prince of Poyang, Boshan, was advanced in title to General Who Garrisons the North;
s0019.idiomatic: Boshan, Prince of Poyang, pacifying north general and inspector of South Xuzhou, was promoted to general who garrisons the north;

s0020.literal: Minister of Personnel Yuan Shu became Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing;
s0020.idiomatic: Yuan Shu, minister of personnel, became left vice director of the Masters of Writing;

s0021.literal: Cloud-Banner General and Administrator of Wuxing Shen Qin became Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing;
s0021.idiomatic: Shen Qin, cloud-banner general and administrator of Wuxing, became right vice director of the Masters of Writing;

s0022.literal: the newly appointed Central Palace Guard General Wu Mingche became General of the Palace Guards;
s0022.idiomatic: Wu Mingche, newly appointed central palace guard general, was made general of the palace guards;

s0023.literal: the newly appointed Central Protector General Shen Ke became Protector General;
s0023.idiomatic: Shen Ke, newly appointed central protector general, was made protector general;

s0024.literal: Editorial footnote marker 3. Pacifying South General and Inspector of Xiangzhou Hua Jiao was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the South;
s0024.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker 3. Hua Jiao, pacifying south general and inspector of Xiangzhou, was promoted to general who pacifies the south;

s0025.literal: Regular Attendant and Censor-in-Chief Xu Ling became Minister of Personnel.
s0025.idiomatic: Xu Ling, regular attendant and censor-in-chief, became minister of personnel.

s0026.literal: On xinhai day of the sixth month, Right Assistant General and Right Grand Master of the Palace Wang Tong was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the Right.
s0026.idiomatic: On xinhai day of the sixth month Wang Tong, right assistant general and right grand master of the palace, was promoted to general who pacifies the right.

s0027.literal: Editorial footnote marker 4. On dingyou day of autumn, the seventh month, Consort Wang was established as empress.
s0027.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker 4. On dingyou day in the seventh month of autumn, Lady Wang was made empress.

s0028.literal: On gengshen day of the tenth month, winter, the imperial carriage performed sacrifice at the imperial temple.
s0028.idiomatic: On gengshen day in the tenth month of winter the emperor offered sacrifice at the ancestral temple.

s0029.literal: On yihai day of the eleventh month, Zhou sent envoys to offer condolences.
s0029.idiomatic: On yihai day of the eleventh month Northern Zhou sent envoys to offer condolences.

s0030.literal: On jiazi day of the twelfth month, Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
s0030.idiomatic: On jiazi day of the twelfth month envoys from Goguryeo presented tribute.

s0031.literal: On guiyou day of the first month, spring, in the first year of Guangda, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Yuan Shu died.
s0031.idiomatic: On guiyou day of the first month in Guangda year 1, Yuan Shu, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, died.

s0032.literal: On yihai day an edict said: "Of old Heaven completed the mandate and bestowed the precious chart; the two sovereigns shone in succession and the nine regions were all governed.
s0032.idiomatic: On yihai day an edict declared: "In antiquity Heaven fulfilled the mandate and granted the sacred chart; two sage rulers succeeded one another and the nine domains were well ruled.

s0033.literal: Editorial footnote marker 5. Pity Our youth and thin virtue—the royal way is not yet made clear. Bearing this sacred vessel is like crossing a spiritual sea; We hope worthy kin will assist in building, and the shepherds will be good, that the realm may be harmonious and punishments long set aside.
s0033.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker 5. We are young and slight in virtue; the royal way is not yet plain. To hold the throne is like crossing a treacherous sea. We look to worthy kinsmen and able governors to aid Us, that the realm may flourish and crime fade away.

s0034.literal: Now the Three Origins change the calendar and all states fill the court; the pure temple has none to follow, yet all officials stand present. Gazing on the vacant seat, We are touched to heartbreak.
s0034.idiomatic: Now the calendar turns and the court is full of envoys; in the ancestral temple there is none to follow, yet every officer is in place. To look on the empty seat breaks Our heart.

s0035.literal: Editorial footnote marker 6. We wish to spread the late emperor's grace and extend it to the black-haired people.
s0035.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker 6. We mean to spread the late emperor's kindness and let it reach the common people.

s0036.literal: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm."
s0036.idiomatic: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm."

s0037.literal: The second year of Tiankang was changed to the first year of Guangda.
s0037.idiomatic: Tiankang year 2 was renamed Guangda year 1.

s0038.literal: Those filial, brotherly, and diligent in farming were granted one rank of nobility.
s0038.idiomatic: Men noted for filial piety, brotherliness, and farming received one step in rank.

s0039.literal: On jimao day General of the Palace Guards Wu Mingche was made Governor of Danyang.
s0039.idiomatic: On jimao day Wu Mingche, general of the palace guards, was made governor of Danyang.

s0040.literal: On xinmao day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the southern suburb.
s0040.idiomatic: On xinmao day the emperor sacrificed in person at the southern suburb.

s0041.literal: On xinhai day of the second month, Proclaiming Martial General and Inspector of South Yuzhou Yu Xiaoxiang plotted rebellion and was executed.
s0041.idiomatic: On xinhai day of the second month Yu Xiaoxiang, proclaiming martial general and inspector of South Yuzhou, was executed for plotting rebellion.

s0042.literal: On guichou day the Prince of Shixing, Bomao, General Who Campaigns East, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Inspector of East Yangzhou, was made Central Army General; Editorial footnote marker 7. Huang Faqu was made General Who Garrisons the North and Inspector of South Xuzhou; the Prince of Poyang, Boshan, General Who Garrisons the North and Inspector of South Xuzhou, was made General Who Garrisons the East and Inspector of East Yangzhou.
s0042.idiomatic: On guichou day Bomao, Prince of Shixing, general who campaigns east, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and inspector of East Yangzhou, was made central army general; Editorial footnote marker 7. Huang Faqu was made general who garrisons the north and inspector of South Xuzhou; Boshan, Prince of Poyang, was shifted to general who garrisons the east and inspector of East Yangzhou.

s0043.literal: On jiawu day of the third month, Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Shen Qin became Palace Attendant and Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
s0043.idiomatic: On jiawu day of the third month Shen Qin, right vice director of the Masters of Writing, became palace attendant and left vice director.

s0045.literal: On yimao day of the fourth month, summer, Venus appeared in daylight.
s0045.idiomatic: On yimao day in the fourth month of summer Venus was seen by day.

s0046.literal: On guisi day of the fifth month, General of the Palace Guards and Governor of Danyang Wu Mingche was made General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Xiangzhou.
s0046.idiomatic: On guisi day of the fifth month Wu Mingche, general of the palace guards and governor of Danyang, was made general who pacifies the south and inspector of Xiangzhou.

s0047.literal: On yiwei day Garrisoning Right General Du Ling was made General of the Palace Guards.
s0047.idiomatic: On yiwei day Du Ling, garrisoning right general, was made general of the palace guards.

s0048.literal: General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Xiangzhou Hua Jiao plotted rebellion; on gengshen day Central Pacifying General Chunyu Liang was made Bearer of the Staff, General Who Campaigns South, and given overall command of the fleet to attack him.
s0048.idiomatic: Hua Jiao, general who pacifies the south and inspector of Xiangzhou, rebelled; on gengshen day Chunyu Liang, central pacifying general, was sent with the staff as general who campaigns south to command the fleet against him.

s0049.literal: On renyin day of the sixth month, Central Army General and Minister of Works Xu Du was advanced in title to General of Chariots and Cavalry and given overall command of the capital armies, advancing overland to strike Xiangzhou.
s0049.idiomatic: On renyin day of the sixth month Xu Du, central army general and minister of works, was promoted to general of chariots and cavalry, placed in overall command of the capital armies, and sent by land against Xiangzhou.

s0050.literal: On guisi day of the intercalary month, Cloud-Banner General the Prince of Xin'an, Bogu, was made Governor of Danyang.
s0050.idiomatic: On guisi day of the intercalary month Bogu, Prince of Xin'an and cloud-banner general, was made governor of Danyang.

s0051.literal: On wushen day of the seventh month, autumn, the imperial son Zhize was established as crown prince; those throughout the realm who were heirs to their fathers were granted one rank of nobility, and dukes, marquises, and officials down received gifts of silk in differing amounts.
s0051.idiomatic: On wushen day in the seventh month of autumn the imperial son Zhize was made crown prince; heirs throughout the realm received one step in rank, and princes, nobles, and officials were given silk gifts in varying measure.

s0052.literal: An edict said: "The rebel Hua Jiao, utterly wicked and utterly cruel, has set up Xiao Kui and plotted against the altars of state.
s0052.idiomatic: An edict declared: "The traitor Hua Jiao, steeped in evil, has enthroned Xiao Kui and menaced the dynasty.

s0053.literal: Casting off kin for the enemy, men and spirits alike are outraged; the royal army advances like lightning by land and water, and the day of decapitation is not far off.
s0053.idiomatic: He has abandoned his own house for the foe; heaven and earth are angered. Our armies rush forward by land and sea, and his end is near.

s0054.literal: His household in the Northern Ward of the Palace Workshop should be put to death, to make clear the law of the state."
s0054.idiomatic: His family held in the Northern Ward of the Palace Workshop are to be executed, that the nation's law may be plain."

s0055.literal: On jingchen day, Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
s0055.idiomatic: On jingchen day envoys from Baekje presented tribute.

s0056.literal: That month Zhou's general the Duke of Chang, Tuoba Ding, led twenty thousand infantry and cavalry into Yingzhou and advanced with Hua Jiao by land and water; Area Commander Chunyu Liang, Wu Mingche, and others gave battle and inflicted a great defeat.
s0056.idiomatic: That month Northern Zhou's general Tuoba Ding, Duke of Chang, entered Yingzhou with twenty thousand foot and horse and joined Hua Jiao on land and water; Chunyu Liang, Wu Mingche, and others fought them and won a great victory.

s0057.literal: Jiao fled alone in a single boat to Jiangling; Tuoba Ding was captured, and more than ten thousand were taken prisoner, with over four thousand horses, and sent to the capital.
s0057.idiomatic: Jiao fled alone by boat to Jiangling; Tuoba Ding was captured, and more than ten thousand prisoners and four thousand horses were sent to the capital.

s0058.literal: On xinsi day of the tenth month, winter, a pardon was granted to Xiang and Ba
s0058.idiomatic: On xinsi day in the tenth month of winter a pardon was granted to Xiang and Ba

s0061.literal: Editorial footnote marker 9. On jiashen day the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the imperial temple.
s0061.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker 9. On jiashen day the emperor offered sacrifice in person at the ancestral temple.

s0062.literal: On jiwei day of the eleventh month, Protector General Shen Ke was made General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Jingzhou.
s0062.idiomatic: On jiwei day of the eleventh month Shen Ke, protector general, was made general who pacifies the west and inspector of Jingzhou.

s0063.literal: On jiazi day Palace Attendant, Central Authority General, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Special Grand Master, and Left Grand Master of the Palace Wang Chong died.
s0063.idiomatic: On jiazi day Wang Chong, palace attendant, central authority general, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, special grand master, and left grand master of the palace, died.

s0064.literal: On gengyin day of the twelfth month, Acting Regular Attendant Kong Yingzhe was made Marquis of Fengsheng Pavilion to continue the sacrifices to Confucius.
s0064.idiomatic: On gengyin day of the twelfth month Kong Yingzhe, acting regular attendant, was made Marquis of Fengsheng Pavilion to maintain the rites to Confucius.

s0065.literal: On jihai day of the first month, spring, in year two, the Prince of Ancheng, Xu, Bearer of the Staff, Area Commander over all armies within and without, Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Grand Mentor, Recorder of the Masters of Writing, and Inspector of Yangzhou, was advanced to Grand Tutor, retained the post of grand mentor, was granted extraordinary honors, and wore shoes in the hall;
s0065.idiomatic: On jihai day in the first month of year 2 Xu, Prince of Ancheng—commander of all armies, grand general of agile cavalry with the staff, grand mentor, recorder of the Masters of Writing, and inspector of Yangzhou—was promoted to grand tutor, kept his grand mentor title, received extraordinary honors, and was allowed to wear shoes in the audience hall;

s0066.literal: Palace Attendant, General Who Campaigns South, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Inspector of Jiangzhou Zhang Zhaoda was advanced in title to Grand General Who Campaigns South;
s0066.idiomatic: Zhang Zhaoda, palace attendant, general who campaigns south, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and inspector of Jiangzhou, was promoted to grand general who campaigns south;

s0067.literal: Central Pacifying General and newly appointed General Who Campaigns South Chunyu Liang became Palace Attendant, Central Army General, and opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes;
s0067.idiomatic: Chunyu Liang, central pacifying general and newly named general who campaigns south, became palace attendant, central army general, and opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes;

s0068.literal: General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Xiangzhou Wu Mingche, on his present title, became opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes and was advanced in title to General Who Garrisons the South;
s0068.idiomatic: Wu Mingche, general who pacifies the south and inspector of Xiangzhou, received a mansion equal to the three dukes on his current rank and was promoted to general who garrisons the south;

s0069.literal: Editorial footnote marker 10. Cloud-Banner General and Inspector of Yingzhou Cheng Lingxi was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the West.
s0069.idiomatic: Editorial footnote marker 10. Cheng Lingxi, cloud-banner general and inspector of Yingzhou, was promoted to general who pacifies the west.

s0070.literal: On gengzi day an edict ordered that soldiers who died in the campaign against Hua Jiao all be given coffins and sent back to their native districts, and their households restored.
s0070.idiomatic: On gengzi day an edict directed that troops who died fighting Hua Jiao receive coffins and be sent home, and their families restored to standing.

s0071.literal: On jiazi day Wu Province was abolished and Poyang commandery was returned to Jiangzhou.
s0071.idiomatic: On jiazi day Wu Province was abolished and Poyang commandery was placed back under Jiangzhou.

s0072.literal: Palace Attendant, Minister of Works, and General of Chariots and Cavalry Xu Du died.
s0072.idiomatic: Xu Du, palace attendant, minister of works, and general of chariots and cavalry, died.

s0073.literal: On xinsi day of the fourth month, summer, Venus appeared in daylight.
s0073.idiomatic: On xinsi day in the fourth month of summer Venus was seen by day.

s0074.literal: On dinghai day Jin'an commandery in East Yangzhou was split off to establish Feng Province.
s0074.idiomatic: On dinghai day Jin'an commandery in East Yangzhou was detached to form Feng Province.

s0075.literal: On jingchen day of the fifth month, Grand Tutor Xu, Prince of Ancheng, presented one jade seal.
s0075.idiomatic: On jingchen day of the fifth month Grand Tutor Xu, Prince of Ancheng, presented a jade seal.

s0076.literal: On dingmao day of the sixth month a comet appeared.
s0076.idiomatic: On dingmao day of the sixth month a comet appeared.

s0077.literal: On jingwu day of the seventh month, autumn, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the imperial temple.
s0077.idiomatic: On jingwu day in the seventh month of autumn the emperor offered sacrifice in person at the ancestral temple.

s0078.literal: On wushen day Silla sent envoys presenting local products.
s0078.idiomatic: On wushen day envoys from Silla presented tribute.

s0079.literal: On renxu day the imperial younger brother Bozhi was established as Prince of Yongyang, and Bomou as Prince of Guiyang.
s0079.idiomatic: On renxu day the emperor's younger brother Bozhi was made Prince of Yongyang and Bomou Prince of Guiyang.

s0080.literal: On jiachen day of the ninth month, Linyi sent envoys presenting local products.
s0080.idiomatic: On jiachen day of the ninth month envoys from Linyi presented tribute.

s0081.literal: On jingwu day Langyaxiu sent envoys presenting local products.
s0081.idiomatic: On jingwu day envoys from Langyaxiu presented tribute.

s0082.literal: Palace Attendant, General Who Campaigns South, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Inspector of Jiangzhou Zhang Zhaoda was made Central Pacifying General.
s0082.idiomatic: Zhang Zhaoda, palace attendant, general who campaigns south, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and inspector of Jiangzhou, was made central pacifying general.

s0083.literal: On wuwu day Venus appeared in daylight.
s0083.idiomatic: On wuwu day Venus was seen by day.

s0084.literal: On gengwu day of the tenth month, winter, the imperial carriage personally sacrificed at the imperial temple.
s0084.idiomatic: On gengwu day in the tenth month of winter the emperor offered sacrifice in person at the ancestral temple.

s0085.literal: On jingwu day of the eleventh month, the former General Who Pacifies the West and Inspector of Jingzhou Shen Ke was made Protector General.
s0085.idiomatic: On jingwu day of the eleventh month Shen Ke, former general who pacifies the west and inspector of Jingzhou, was made protector general.

s0086.literal: On renzi day General Who Garrisons the North, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and Inspector of South Xuzhou Huang Faqu was made General Who Garrisons the West and Inspector of Yingzhou; the newly appointed Central Army General, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, Chunyu Liang was made General Who Garrisons the North and Inspector of South Xuzhou.
s0086.idiomatic: On renzi day Huang Faqu, general who garrisons the north, opener of the mansion equal to the three dukes, and inspector of South Xuzhou, was made general who garrisons the west and inspector of Yingzhou; Chunyu Liang, newly appointed central army general with a mansion equal to the three dukes, was made general who garrisons the north and inspector of South Xuzhou.

s0087.literal: On jiayin day Dowager Empress Cixun gathered the ministers in the court hall and issued an order:
s0087.idiomatic: On jiayin day Dowager Empress Cixun assembled the ministers in the audience hall and proclaimed:

s0088.literal: Central Army with staff equal to the three dukes, Garrisoning North with staff equal to the three dukes, Garrisoning Right General, Protector General, and the eight chief ministers: In the last days of Liang's mandate, Editorial footnote marker 11. the realm seethed; the black-haired people were nearly wiped out.
s0088.idiomatic: To the central army commander with staff equal to the three dukes, the garrisoning north commander with equal honors, the garrisoning right general, the protector general, and the eight chief ministers: In the closing years of Liang, Editorial footnote marker 11. the empire boiled over and the common people were all but destroyed.

s0089.literal: The Founder, Martial Emperor, put down disorder and restored the right, received the chart and held the tally, rehung the three luminaries, and mended the two principles;
s0089.idiomatic: The Founder put rebellion down and righted the realm, took the mandate and ruled by the tally, restored heaven's lights, and repaired earth's order;

s0090.literal: Emperor Wen, Literary Emperor, succeeded the great foundation, spread the precious enterprise, nurtured the central lands, and quieted the outer wilds;
s0090.idiomatic: Emperor Wen carried on the great foundation, enlarged the royal work, nourished the heartland, and pacified the frontier;

s0091.literal: both trembled in caution and toiled in founding, hoping that the bronze vessel's fortune might rise like Yin and Xia.
s0091.idiomatic: both labored in fear and sweat to build the state, hoping the dynasty might flourish like Yin and Xia.

s0092.literal: Bozong, when in the eastern palace, had no fair reputation; once he ascended the supreme height, he gave free rein to wickedness and lust.
s0092.idiomatic: Bozong had no good name as heir apparent; once he took the throne he abandoned himself to cruelty and debauchery.

s0093.literal: Dwelling in the mourning hut, he was by no means sorrowful; he did not keep apart from the inner consorts, and visiting lodges followed one after another—was it only the clothes and carts he admitted, for which the Director of the Imperial Clan reproved him, or children born in deep mourning, for which the Right Mentor was mocked?
s0093.idiomatic: In the mourning lodge he showed no grief; he would not stay from the inner consorts, and one visiting bed followed another—not only the garments and carriages he took in, which the director of the imperial clan censured, but children born while he wore mourning, which made a mockery of the right mentor.

s0094.literal: On what could the seven hundred years of Zhou depend? His three thousand offenses were great indeed.
s0094.idiomatic: How could he sustain a reign like Zhou's seven hundred years? His offenses were greater still.

s0095.literal: Moreover he squandered gold and silk to fill the pepper chambers; the inner treasury and the arsenals, the stores of the state—before the granaries were full, all were already emptied.
s0095.idiomatic: He poured out gold and silk to stock the inner quarters; palace treasuries, armories, and state reserves were drained before the bins were full.

s0096.literal: The Grand Tutor personally received the entrustment and guarded the palace gates; the late emperor's testament was close-woven in meaning, deep as a rampart wall—yet the ceremonial road was not yet driven, and not even a day passed before he still sent Liu Shizhi, Yin Buxin, and others to speak openly of driving him out.
s0096.idiomatic: The Grand Tutor had been entrusted in person to guard the palace; the late emperor's will bound him like a wall—yet the emperor never came to him on the first day of mourning, and on the very next day sent Liu Shizhi, Yin Buxin, and others to push him aside.

s0097.literal: Han Ziga, a petty fellow, was frivolous and rash; the emperor gave him his inmost trust and relied on him, and secret plots for calamity rose within the palace walls.
s0097.idiomatic: Han Ziga, a low creature, was light and reckless; the emperor trusted him with his heart, and treason brewed inside the palace.

s0098.literal: Yuan Xiang though held office, removed only those at the ruler's side.
s0098.idiomatic: Yuan Xiang remained in post, but only to clear rivals from the emperor's side.

s0099.literal: Moreover, because Yu Xiaoxiang was close to the capital, he was summoned; the penalty of disaster fell on the wicked band themselves, and the numen of the altars destroyed the evil vapors.
s0099.idiomatic: Because Yu Xiaoxiang lay near the capital he was called in; the guilty destroyed themselves, and the spirits of the state swept away the foul air.

s0100.literal: Then he secretly ordered Hua Jiao to raise troops upriver; the fate of the dynasty was in peril, and the throne nearly passed to an ugly breed.
s0100.idiomatic: Then he secretly instructed Hua Jiao to take up arms on the upper Yangtze; the realm trembled and the throne nearly fell to a usurper's line.
